descriptions.w3d_d21e_register_widget_properties_8021: Registers StartDelay (0x801ebf38); registers EndDelay (0x801ebf38); creates the Position vector binding (0x801f0210) reset to 0.0f; creates the Scale vector binding (0x801f0210) reset to (50, 50, 0) (0x803b61e4 = 50.0f); resets the IncomingAnimation string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the OutgoingAnimation string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the HighlightedAnimation string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the ActivatedAnimation string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the ItemName string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the LeftItem string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the RightItem string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the UpItem string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the DownItem string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the ToolTipId string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; registers FontSizeOverride (0x801ec52c); resets the EnableSwitch string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the IncomingAudio string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the OutgoingAudio string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the HighlightedAudio string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; resets the ActivatedAudio string binding (0x801ed24c) to the shared empty string; calls the refresh routine 0x801e8d9c and returns 0. Vector resets use 0x803b61e0 (0.0f).
